from flowguard.intent import rule, row


@rule("BORROW", decides="may borrow again", fields={"days": int, "member": bool},
      source="owner R1: 逾期超过 10 天就不能再借，会员除外。", anchor="MAY_BORROW")
def BORROW(days, member):
    return days <= 10 or member


BORROW.rows(row(days=11, member=False, expect=False, why="the eleventh day overdue blocks a non-member"))
